ambient: Gulls wheel overhead and will not follow you in.
nodes.description: A ragged opening in the cliff, half-drowned at high tide. Cold air breathes out of it, smelling of salt and old stone.
features: A rusted mooring ring, worn bright on one side by a rope long gone.
nodes.name: The Cave Mouth

ambient: The kelp stirs in a draught you cannot feel.
nodes.description: Dried kelp hangs from the ceiling in long curtains that rustle as you pass.
nodes.name: Glistening Kelp Hall

ambient: A drop of water lands on your neck.
nodes.description: A grotto lit by a faint green glow from algae on the ceiling.
nodes.name: Brackish Grotto

ambient: A bubble rises from the black water and breaks.
nodes.description: A chamber where seawater collects and slowly sours.
nodes.name: Silent Sump

ambient: Your footsteps come back to you a moment late.
nodes.description: A crack in the rock just wide enough to pass, its walls slick with weed.
nodes.name: Crooked Passage

ambient: The kelp stirs in a draught you cannot feel.
nodes.description: A tall chamber festooned with kelp, as if the sea once filled it to the roof.
features: Something has knotted the kelp into crude, careful shapes.
nodes.name: Brackish Kelp Hall

nodes.description: A long gallery with pillars of dripstone, like the nave of a drowned church.
features: Tide-lines on the pillars, far above your head.
nodes.name: Echoing Gallery

nodes.description: A high, narrow gallery. Light from somewhere far above falls in a single thread.
nodes.name: Narrow Gallery
